b: ^Sa oled see uus pärija. Ma nägin autot.
^en: You're the new heir. I saw the car.
^Leida Kaseoja. Üheksakümmend üks. Ära vaata nii, ma kuulen paremini kui sina.
^en: Leida Kaseoja. Ninety-one. Don't look like that, I hear better than you do.
^Ema ütles, et ta kirjutas kõik üles. Ma ei leidnud seda kunagi.
^en: Mother said she wrote it all down. I never found it.
^Jälle sina. Istu, kui tahad. Tamm ei pahanda.
^en: You again. Sit, if you like. The oak doesn't mind.

leida_menu: ^Anna Leidale kiri. %% Give Leida the letter.
^Põhjapõld on niit. %% The north field is meadow.
^Kaev on veel alles. %% The well is still here.
^Kivi põllu serval. %% The stone at the field edge.
^Mis siin enne oli? %% What was here before?
^Ma lähen vaatan. %% I'll go and look.

c-1: ^See aasta, kui nad selle lõpuks sisse said. Isa ütles, et vanaisa raud ei murdu kunagi. Ei murdunudki.
^en: The year they finally got it in. Father said grandfather's iron never broke. It never did.
c-2: ^Magus vesi. Mõisa oma oli kibe, ütles ema. Ma ei tea, kust ta seda teadis.
^en: Sweet water. The manor's was bitter, mother said. I don't know how she knew.
c-3: ^Kolm puud kannavad veel. Ma korjan need iga sügis, ja iga sügis on neid vähem.
^en: Three trees still bear. I pick them every autumn, and every autumn there are fewer.
c-4: ^Isa raius selle ise. Esimene kord tuli viltu. Teine kord õigesti.
^en: Father cut it himself. The first time came out crooked. The second time right.
c-6: ^Kõik. Mõis, kool, meie talu, kaev. Sa seisad selle peal.
^en: Everything. The manor, the school, our farm, the well. You're standing on it.
c-7: ^Mine. Ma olen siin. Ma olen alati siin.
^en: Go. I'm here. I'm always here.

give_letter: ^Ta ei loe seda kohe. Ta hoiab seda.
^en: She does not read it at once. She holds it.
^„Esimesest lõikusest.“ Ema käekiri. Ma tundsin selle ära enne, kui lugesin.
^en: "From the first harvest." Mother's hand. I knew it before I read it.
^Kast on kõige vanema õunapuu all. Ta ütleb seda siin. Ma oleksin pidanud arvama.
^en: The box is under the oldest apple tree. She says so here. I should have guessed.
sit: ^en: She pats the root beside her.
^Noh. Räägime siis sellest, mis alles on.
^en: Well. Let's talk about what's still here.
